## Install Package and Load Library

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Create the bar plot and smooth line plot using ggplot2
ggplot(usa_data, aes(x = Age, y = Deaths, fill = Effect_Duration)) +  # set x-axis (Age), y-axis (Deaths), fill color by Effect_Duration
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +  # bar plot with side-by-side bars
  
  # added a dashed line showing trends across age groups for each Effect_Duration group
  geom_smooth(aes(group = Effect_Duration, color = Effect_Duration),
              method = "lm",           # linear model (trend line)
              se = FALSE,              # se=FALSE
              linetype = "dashed",     # dashed line style
              size = 1.2) +            # line thickness
  
  # faceting
  facet_wrap(~ Effect_Duration) +
  
  # customize plot titles and axis labels
  labs(
    title = "Age Group Death Distribution by Effect Duration",  
    subtitle = "Weighted by total deaths per age group",        
    x = "Age Group",                                            
    y = "Total Deaths"                                          
  ) +
  
  # theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  # better aesthetics
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),                         
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),           
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),                       
    legend.position = "none"                                       # hide legend (since facets already label groups)
  ) +
  
  # applied color palettes to bars and smooth lines for better visual differentiation
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +   # Softer colors for bar fill
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")   # Darker colors for trend lines

```


Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
